title: Led InnerSource adoption that cut security-scanner setup from months to minutes
summary: I guided an IT platform team off one-off pipelines and onto reusable GitHub workflows any product team could adopt, so wiring in the required security scanner became self-service.
what_would_have_happened: Each product team would keep spending months wiring the mandatory security scanner into its pipeline by hand.
the_call: Set a platform model where the platform team offers self-service workflows and product teams adopt them on their own.
what_i_did: Taught the team how platform teams serve product teams, guided it to build reusable workflows into the SaaS factory pipelines, and demonstrated a workflow that connects a project to the scanner in a few clicks.
what_changed: What took months now takes minutes. My manager called it a vision that I implemented and sold to the teams, and those teams now build reusable workflows for everyone.

metrics.label: time to wire a project to the required security scanner

quotes.text: This wasn't just a "task"; this was a vision, an implementation of the vision, and a successful selling of the vision to teams that needed it to be sold to them for their own success.
